description: Where to park cash taken OUT of the market: a ranked shortlist of EUR and USD short-term instruments and physical gold with all-in cost, 90-day yield, drawdown and EU availability. Present it in the order returned.

currency.description: Narrow to one currency's two groups (cash + gold). Omit for all four.

include_notes.description: Include the per-row prose (whenToChoose, caveat, contrast, availability, venue, entryCost) and the traps list. Default false — static copy; describe_dataset carries it.

include_series.description: Include each instrument's ~60-point [unix_seconds, close] sparkline. Default false — the series are most of the payload's bytes and the fee/yield comparison never needs them.

name: get_capital_parking
